description:
Those with special abilities possess red eyes. Ability users are considered dangerous and must be arrested or executed on sight when discovered. However, if they serve under the imperial house, they are recognized as their property. The Empire and The Imperial house demand their royalty in exchange for protection.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.postype.com/@guswn3702/series/1519802)  
[Official English Translation](https://www.postype.com/@guswn3702/series/1519804)

##### NOTE: Expected to have 20 episodes with R19+ side stories.
